company_grievance.en:
SUBJECT: Refund of Rs 3,499 for returned headphones still pending, order [ORDER NUMBER]

DESCRIPTION:
Dear Grievance Officer,

I bought headphones from ShopKart on 28 Sep 2026 for Rs 3,499 (order [ORDER NUMBER]). They were faulty, so I returned them on [DATE OF RETURN]. The refund of Rs 3,499 has not reached me.

On 15 Oct 2026 I made a written complaint to ShopKart (reference [COMPLAINT REFERENCE NUMBER]). I have not received a resolution or the refund.

Under the Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules 2020, rule 4(5), the grievance officer must acknowledge a complaint within 48 hours and resolve it within one month. My complaint should have been acknowledged by 17 Oct 2026 and resolved by 15 Nov 2026. Both dates have passed.

I paid using [PAYMENT METHOD] ending [CARD/ACCOUNT LAST 4 DIGITS].

Please resolve this promptly.

Regards,
[YOUR FULL NAME]
[REGISTERED MOBILE NUMBER]
[REGISTERED EMAIL ADDRESS]

RELIEF SOUGHT:
1. Credit the full refund of Rs 3,499 to my original payment method.
2. Share the refund transaction reference so I can trace it.
3. Explain in writing why the refund is delayed.
4. Give a ticket number for this grievance and reply in writing.

DOCUMENTS TO ATTACH:
- Order confirmation or invoice for order [ORDER NUMBER]
- Proof of return (pickup confirmation or return receipt)
- Copy of my written complaint dated 15 Oct 2026
- Any replies received from ShopKart
- Bank or card statement showing the payment of Rs 3,499 and no refund

nch.en:
SUBJECT: Refund of ₹3,499 from ShopKart for returned faulty headphones not received

DESCRIPTION:
My name is [YOUR FULL NAME]. I want to register a complaint against ShopKart, an e-commerce company.

On 28 Sep 2026, I bought headphones from ShopKart for ₹3,499. My order number is [ORDER NUMBER]. The headphones were faulty, so I returned them on [DATE OF RETURN].

My refund of ₹3,499 has not arrived. On 15 Oct 2026, I complained to ShopKart in writing. My reference number is [COMPLAINT REFERENCE NUMBER]. I have only been told that the refund is being processed. I have received no resolution, and the money has not been credited.

I paid using [PAYMENT METHOD], with account or card ending in [ACCOUNT OR CARD LAST 4 DIGITS].

I understand the National Consumer Helpline, under the Department of Consumer Affairs, takes up complaints with the company before a consumer goes to a commission. I request your help in raising this with ShopKart.

RELIEF SOUGHT:
1. Please take up my complaint with ShopKart.
2. Please ask ShopKart to credit the refund of ₹3,499 to my original payment method.
3. Please ask ShopKart to confirm in writing the refund date and transaction reference.
4. Please give me an NCH docket number for this complaint.

DOCUMENTS TO ATTACH:
- Order invoice or confirmation for the purchase dated 28 Sep 2026
- Proof of return (pickup receipt or return confirmation)
- Copy of my written complaint to ShopKart dated 15 Oct 2026
- ShopKart's replies saying the refund is being processed
- Bank or card statement showing no refund credited (last 4 digits only)

consumer_commission.hi:
SUBJECT: ShopKart द्वारा लौटाए गए खराब हेडफ़ोन के ₹3,499 का रिफंड न देने के विरुद्ध शिकायत

DESCRIPTION:
सेवा में,
माननीय जिला उपभोक्ता विवाद प्रतितोष आयोग, [YOUR DISTRICT]

मैं, [YOUR FULL NAME], [YOUR ADDRESS], यह शिकायत ShopKart के विरुद्ध दर्ज कर रहा/रही हूँ।

मैंने 28 Sep 2026 को ShopKart से ₹3,499 में हेडफ़ोन खरीदे। ऑर्डर नंबर [ORDER NUMBER] है। हेडफ़ोन खराब निकले, इसलिए मैंने उन्हें [DATE OF RETURN] को ShopKart को लौटा दिया।

रिफंड न मिलने पर मैंने 15 Oct 2026 को ShopKart को लिखित शिकायत दी। इसका संदर्भ नंबर [COMPLAINT REFERENCE NUMBER] है। आज तक मुझे ₹3,499 का रिफंड नहीं मिला है और मेरी शिकायत का समाधान नहीं हुआ है।

Consumer Protection Act 2019, section 69 के अनुसार शिकायत 2 वर्ष के भीतर दर्ज करनी होती है। यह शिकायत समय-सीमा (28 Sep 2028) के भीतर है।

Consumer Protection (Jurisdiction) Rules 2021, G.S.R. 912(E) के अनुसार ₹50 लाख तक की राशि के मामले जिला आयोग सुनता है। इसलिए यह आयोग इस मामले को सुन सकता है।

Consumer commission filing-fee notification G.S.R. 606(E), 2023 के अनुसार ₹5 लाख तक की राशि पर कोई शुल्क नहीं लगता।

यह शिकायत e-Jagriti, Department of Consumer Affairs (e-jagriti.gov.in) के माध्यम से दर्ज की जा रही है।

RELIEF SOUGHT:
1. ShopKart को ₹3,499 का पूरा रिफंड देने का निर्देश दिया जाए।
2. आयोग जो अन्य राहत उचित समझे, वह प्रदान की जाए।

DOCUMENTS TO ATTACH:
- ऑर्डर कन्फर्मेशन या इनवॉइस
- भुगतान का प्रमाण, जैसे बैंक स्टेटमेंट ([ACCOUNT LAST 4 DIGITS])
- उत्पाद वापसी (रिटर्न) का प्रमाण
- 15 Oct 2026 की लिखित शिकायत की प्रति
- पहचान पत्र और पते का प्रमाण
consumer_commission.en:
SUBJECT: Consumer complaint against ShopKart for non-payment of refund of Rs 3,499 for returned headphones

DESCRIPTION:
I, [YOUR FULL NAME], of [YOUR FULL ADDRESS], file this complaint against ShopKart, an e-commerce seller, of [SHOPKART REGISTERED ADDRESS].

On 28 Sep 2026, I bought headphones from ShopKart for Rs 3,499 (order number [ORDER NUMBER]). The headphones were faulty. I returned them to ShopKart on [DATE OF RETURN].

I have not received the refund of Rs 3,499. On 15 Oct 2026, I complained to ShopKart in writing about the refund. My complaint reference is [COMPLAINT REFERENCE NUMBER]. The refund has still not been credited.

I am filing within the time limit in the Consumer Protection Act 2019, section 69, which allows 2 years from the cause of action. The transaction took place on 28 Sep 2026.

I paid Rs 3,499. So under the Consumer Protection (Jurisdiction) Rules 2021, G.S.R. 912(E), this District Commission can hear my complaint. Under the Consumer commission filing-fee notification G.S.R. 606(E), 2023, no filing fee applies. I am filing online through e-Jagriti, Department of Consumer Affairs.

RELIEF SOUGHT:
1. Direct ShopKart to refund Rs 3,499 to me.
2. Award compensation for the delay and inconvenience, as the Commission thinks fit.
3. Award the costs of this complaint, as the Commission thinks fit.

DOCUMENTS TO ATTACH:
- Order confirmation or invoice for Rs 3,499 dated 28 Sep 2026
- Proof of return of the headphones (pickup receipt or tracking details)
- Copy of my written complaint to ShopKart dated 15 Oct 2026
- Any messages or emails from ShopKart about the refund
- Bank or card statement showing the payment, with only the last 4 digits visible: [ACCOUNT LAST 4 DIGITS]
- Copy of my identity proof
